profile.Name: Name
profile.This feature is only available when pass: This feature is only available when passwords are stored locally
profile.When you store your passwords locally, t: When you store your passwords locally, they are saved in the local storage of your Internet browser.
profile.There are certain browser cleaning opera: There are certain browser cleaning operations that may delete this information, and may cause you to lose your passwords.
profile.It is therefore recommended to regularly: It is therefore recommended to regularly download backups via this page and store them on a secure storage device.
profile.In case you accidentally delete your dat: In case you accidentally delete your data, you can upload a backup copy by clicking on the "Import backup" button.
profile.In addition, you can upload your backups: In addition, you can upload your backups to other computers to have your passwords available on different devices.
profile.The backup includes only folders you own: The backup includes only folders you own. Folders shared with you are excluded.
profile.Importing this backup back into a backen: Importing this backup back into a backend instance is not supported yet, but the file can be imported in local mode.
profile.Error importing data. Submitted file is: Error importing data. Submitted file is not a valid backup.
profile.Passager encrypts all your data before s: Passager encrypts all your data before sending it to your organization servers (this include passwords, and any other sensible data you store in Passager). By doing this, you can be sure that only you and the people with whom you may have shared your folders, can have access to your data.
profile.In order to achieve this high security l: In order to achieve this high security level, Passager relies in two main components:
profile.The first one, is your user encryption k: The first one, is your user encryption key (also referred as private key). This key is randomly generated when you login for the first time, and it is the unique key that can decrypt your data. By default this key is managed by Passager, and is stored in your organization servers.
The second one, is your master password. It's a password you choose when you login for the first time, and it is used to encrypt your private key in order to ensure that nobody from your organization or any hypothetical attacker can read your private key, which would allow to decrypt your information.
profile.This system guarantees the safety of you: This system guarantees the safety of your data, as long as your master password is strong-enough.
profile.However, in case an additional level of: However, in case an additional level of security is required, you can opt to manage your user private key by yourself. This means that, once you enable this mode, your private key will no-longer be stored by your organization, and you will be in charge of storing it in a safe place.
profile.As Passager needs your private key to wo: As Passager needs your private key to work, you will need to provide it the first time you login on a new device. After logging in, your private key will be stored in your device and you will not be asked for it again unless you remove Passager's data, or you login on a new device.
profile.Please note, the same way as your master: Please note, the same way as your master password, you will not be able to recover your private key if you lose it. So, please, make sure you store it in a safe place
profile.or you can lose access to your data fore: or you can lose access to your data forever.
profile.To help you store your private key, once: To help you store your private key, once you enable the advanced security mode, Passager will allow you to download and print an access kit, which will contain your private key splitted in several QR codes that you will be able to directly scan with your phone when you need to login on a new device.
profile.The improved security mode is enabled. Y: The improved security mode is enabled. You will need to provide your private key when logging in on a new device.
profile.Please download and print your access ki: Please download and print your access kit to be sure you do not lose access to your data.
profile.You will need your user private key when: You will need your user private key when logging in on a new device. Store this document on a safe place.
profile.When accessing from a mobile phone, you: When accessing from a mobile phone, you can scan the following QR codes to provide your private key.
profile.It is recommended to remember the master: It is recommended to remember the master password and not writting it down anywhere. However, in case you feel more comfortable writting it down, you can do it here:
profile.If you prefer to not print this file, yo: If you prefer to not print this file, you can directly copy and paste the following text. In case of printing this document (which is recommended), you can skip this page.

privacy.You are going to use Passager by connect: You are going to use Passager by connecting to an external server that belongs to your organization.
privacy.This will allow you to access your passw: This will allow you to access your passwords from any device, as well as share these passwords with other people from your organization.
privacy.We want you to understand precisely what: We want you to understand precisely what data your organization will receive, and what aspects you should pay special attention to. Please read this notice carefully.
privacy.Never connect Passager to an unknown ser: Never connect Passager to an unknown service URL or that does not belong to your organization.
privacy.Always check that the URL you are connec: Always check that the URL you are connecting to belongs to the one provided by your organization, distrust in case of doubt.
privacy.Never, under any circumstances, access P: Never, under any circumstances, access Passager through a URL you do not know who is the owner.
privacy.What data will be sent to your organizat: What data will be sent to your organization
privacy.While you use Passager with your organiz: While you use Passager with your organization, the data you enter in Passager will be received and stored by your organization.
privacy.This includes data such as Email, folder: This includes data such as Email, folder names, and your passwords.
privacy.Your master key will NOT be stored by yo: Your master key will NOT be stored by your organization and you should NEVER share it with ANYONE.
privacy.What data your organization will not be: What data your organization will not be able to read
privacy.Although your organization stores all th: Although your organization stores all the data you enter in Passager, your usernames and passwords are encrypted with your master key so that only you can read them.
privacy.That means that although your organizati: That means that although your organization will save your usernames and passwords, if they try to read them they will only see a set of illegible characters.
privacy.Only you with your master password and t: Only you with your master password and the people with whom you have shared a folder, will be able to read the usernames and passwords.
privacy.What other privacy aspects should you kn: What other privacy aspects should you know
privacy.Contact your organization to clarify the: Contact your organization to clarify the legal basis of the data processing, the retention period, and other details regarding the privacy policy.
privacy.Keep in mind that depending on the appli: Keep in mind that depending on the applicable legislation in your jurisdiction, you may have data protection rights.
privacy.The creators of Passager do not receive: The creators of Passager do not receive any type of personal data from you when you use Passager. Please contact your organization if you have any questions about the privacy policy.
privacy.I understand and accept this privacy not: I understand and accept this privacy notice
